visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a large, spherical orange mascot with blue oval eyes and green leafy stems on its head, placed on a green artificial turf. (2) Medium full shot of a man in a black vest and a woman in a white top and jeans dancing excitedly in front of a giant video game console backdrop labeled 'STAYREAL GUITAR LEGEND'. (3) The woman smiles and points at a large bubble tea cup prop while standing next to a character statue; the scene then cuts to her looking into a white capsule machine filled with white balls in a space-themed room with a 'Goodnight Earth' sign. (4) The pair poses in front of a mural depicting 'STINKY TOFU' with a warning hand sign; then they are seen sitting on a yellow bench in front of a green wall with the text 'Summer Letter'. (5) Sequence of shots showing the man and woman swapping giant character head masks (black, pink, and white rabbits) in front of an orange wall with carrot patterns. (6) They throw giant plush dice in a colorful room with game-like posters, followed by the woman and man individually hugging an orange mascot plushie. (7) Both pose and wave in front of a pink wall densely covered with colorful smiling flower plushies. (8) The man performs a dramatic split on the floor in front of a 'STAYREAL' height chart wall while the woman poses behind him. (9) A close-up of a signature and a bear doodle on a yellow wall; then the couple walks past a mural featuring Taipei landmarks and a cartoon bunny. (10) Montage of them posing in an art gallery setting with various colorful statues and paintings. (11) Final shot of them standing outside in front of a massive inflatable orange mascot, gesturing towards it as hearts and sparkles are edited over the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy J-Pop/Rock music begins with a bright synthesizer melody and driving electronic drums at 145 BPM. A clear female voice sings in Mandarin with a cheerful, high-arousal tone. (2) A sharp 'pop' sound effect occurs as the visual cuts to a new scene, while the music continues its rhythmic verse. (3) A digital 'whoosh' transition SFX is layered over the music, marking a rapid sequence of scene changes. (4) The music remains constant in its upbeat major mode, featuring distorted electric guitar riffs in the background as the singer sustains a melodic phrase. (5) A final sparkle SFX coincides with the hearts appearing on screen, ending on a bright musical chord.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and promote a visit to the STAYREAL 15th-anniversary exhibition in Taipei, showcasing the interactive installations, merchandise, and fun atmosphere to encourage others to visit.
